name: MCN6
tagline: Slim Intel mini PC with dual HDMI 2.0 and M.2 SATA / NVMe storage
description: MCN6 combines Intel N-series options, one DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM slot for 8-16 GB and M.2 2242 SATA / NVMe storage in a 33 mm-high enclosure. Dual HDMI 2.0 outputs, four 10 Gbps USB 3.2 ports and Gigabit Ethernet connect desktop devices. Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 are optional, and TPM 2.0 is supported.
featureHeading: Compact desktop connections and clear configuration choices
advantageSummary: Compare the memory, display, storage and wireless options for this model, including TPM 2.0 support and the listed power and environment limits.
